value.name: SC_SITE_NO
value.source_clause: law SC_SITE_NO := IF THIS(SC_SITE,v) THEN THIS(SC_CASE,SITE(v,"NO"));

value.name: SC_STRICT
value.source_clause: law SC_STRICT := IF THIS(SC_COMPLETE,m), THIS(SC_COVER_ROOT,root), GOES_WITH(SC_EMPTY_OPEN,m,root), GOES_WITH(SC_DISCHARGED,m,a,b) THEN THIS(SC_STRICT,m);
